teacher_target_review.evidence: Corrected teacher/direct-body FK excess over matched GT persists; current FK GT loss covers hands/feet at all future frames and full-body seam only first two future frames.
teacher_target_review.target: Mean squared xyz error from predicted FK body21 positions relative to predicted root to GT direct body21 positions relative to GT root, future frames2:16.
teacher_target_review.preserved: Original position MSE, rotation L1, hand/foot FK weight3 and fullbody seam weight0.5494500113; retain learned first future frame.
teacher_target_review.gradient_scope: Direct gradient to rotation-derived body positions; root cancels. Shared trunk can couple both heads; terminal rotations still require original rotation and hand losses.
teacher_target_review.calibration: One preregistered real-batch magnitude/gradient calibration before any fixed-budget from-random teacher run; no coefficient or run id selected in this session.
teacher_target_review.limitations: Target validity is supported; training efficacy for FK physics and native FID is untested. Student-vs-teacher differences still combine weights and sampler family.
teacher_target_review.rejected: R3 hard rebase, large-output subtraction, and unanchored prediction-to-prediction agreement.

limitations: Joint deployment intervention fixes LERP direction and shared position/root/rotation grid; individual causal contributions are not separately identified.
Old physical schemas and corrected schema5 remain separate references. GT residual remains0.01644cm, not zero.
Native coarse-position FID and semantic inputs are exactly unchanged; FK body changes do not imply native FID improvement.
Current teacher-vs-student comparison includes both weights and sampler-family differences.
Diversity is newly derived from sealed embeddings using exact legacy RNG order, not a previously archived Table3 scalar; absolute point has no new CI.
Seven GPUs had other processes at representation start; its timings are contended workload observations, not standalone latency.
Original GT and R2 per-sequence payloads lack safety fields; corrected absolute guards and existing CM old/new safety are reported.

failures.reason: CUDA timing reset before lazy initialization; no motion produced; retained and recovered under new id/source.
